meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
₹500 ke andar **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Wash (100 ml)** sabse accha option hai—khaaskar agar oily skin ke saath blackheads, pimples ya clogged pores bhi hain. Iski keemat lagbhag ₹278–₹299 hai.[1][2]

**Skin concern ke hisaab se options:**

- **Oily + acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA — ~₹299.[1]
- **Sensitive oily skin:** Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash — ~₹224, ya Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash — ~₹239–₹349.[3][4]
- **Sirf excess oil, acne nahi:** Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser — kabhi-kabhi ₹350–₹500 ke aas-paas milta hai, lekin price seller ke hisaab se badal sakti hai.[5]
- **Sabse budget-friendly:** Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash — ~₹120–₹200.[4]

**Meri recommendation:** Minimalist face wash ko pehle **raat mein 3–4 din/hafta** use karein; dryness ya jalan ho to frequency kam kar dein. Face wash ke baad light, non-comedogenic moisturiser aur din mein sunscreen lagayein. Salicylic-acid products ko overuse na karein.
